summary: This file exports a configuration object that sets up theme-related settings. Specifically, it defines a default image that will be used when someone shares a post from this site on social media platforms like Twitter or Facebook.

explanations.1: The 'export default' syntax means this object is the main thing this file sends out, so other files can import and use it.
explanations.4: The 'image' property is a path to a picture file; social media sites will grab this image and display it as a preview when a link is shared.
